paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy describes the ways in which we collect, store, use and protect your personal information and it is important for you to review this Privacy Policy. By "personal information" we mean information that can be linked to a specific person and can be used to identify that person.

We do not consider anonymized information to be personal information, as it cannot be used to identify a specific person. We collect personal information from you when you use the relevant Sites and Services (including when you buy and sell goods or when you contact or email our customer support team). By providing us with your personal information, you expressly consent to us processing your personal information in accordance with the terms of our Privacy Policy.

We may amend our Privacy Policy at any time by posting a revised version on the Site. The revised version will be effective at the time it is posted, and after such posting, your continued use of the Site will constitute your express consent to our continuing processing of your personal information in accordance with the terms of our revised Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Our collection of your personal information
paragraphs: As part of your registration on or use of the Site, you will be asked to provide us with certain personal information, such as your name, shipping address, email address and/or phone number and other similar information as well as some additional information about you such as your date of birth or other identifying information.

In addition, in order for us to verify your identity, we may need to ask you for valid proof of your identity (for example in the form of a copy of your passport, visa or residence permit, national identity card and/or driver's licence).
Following your registration on the Site, you must not post any personal information (including any financial information) anywhere on the Site other than in the Account section of the Site.

Restricting the posting of personal information to the Account section of the Site protects you from the possibility of fraud or identity theft. Your posting of any Personal Information anywhere on the Site other than in the Account section of the Site may lead to suspension of your use of the Site.
We will collect transactional information based on your activities using the Site (such as buying and selling items).

sections.title: Refund and return policy
paragraphs: Enjoy shopping with our return policy features below:

sections.title: 1. Standard returns (14 days)
paragraphs: You have 14 days from the date you received any item to apply for a return. Where the buyer bears the return shipping costs, and the return cost is 50 pounds. As for the shipping cost, it is shown in the invoice. We accept returns, provided that the product is intact and unopened, and the product carton also and all its accessories are intact. After verifying that, the amount will be returned within 14 working days.

sections.title: 2. Defective or non-conforming items
paragraphs: If the item is defective or does not work properly or even does not match the description of the site, you have the right to return it within 14 days from the date of its receipt and you will be refunded the price of the item in addition to the shipping cost that you paid upon purchase.

sections.title: 3. Refund processing time
paragraphs: The amount will be transferred within 14 working days.

sections.title: I received a defective/damaged product, can I get a refund?
paragraphs: If the product you received is damaged or if it has a defect, you can return the product within 14 days from the date of its receipt, provided that it is in the same condition in which you received it with the original box intact and/or the packaging intact. As soon as we receive the returned product, we will examine it, and if the product is found to be defective or damaged, we will return the product value paid with any shipping fees that were paid within one week from the date of your request to return the product.

sections.title: When is a return not possible?
paragraphs: There are some cases where it is difficult for us to support returns: if a return is requested outside the specified time frame of 14 days or 30 days for defective or non-conforming products from the day of receipt; if the product is used, damaged or not in the same condition that you received it; defective products covered by the manufacturer's warranty; any consumable product that has been used or installed; anything missing from the package you received including price tags, labels, original packaging, free accessories and accessories; fragile and personal hygiene products.

sections.title: Who pays the shipping fees when returning the product?
paragraphs: You can return the product within 14 days of the delivery date and it is shipped by the customer to our address and the Arcwood store does not bear the shipping cost unless the product is not intact or broken, then the shipping cost will be borne by the Arcwood store.

sections.title: I want my money back, why hasn't it been transferred to me yet?
paragraphs: All financial transactions, including refunds, returns, or any transfer, take between 3–14 working days.

sections.title: What is the delivery time for orders at Arcwood?
paragraphs: The delivery time for orders ranges between 3–5 working days on regular days, and on seasonal days it may reach 10 days.

sections.title: I have a complaint, why haven't I received a response yet?
paragraphs: Responding to complaints takes place within 72 hours from the time of the complaint. As for resolving problems and complaints, it may take up to 14 working days.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about returns? Contact us at info@arcwood-eg.com or visit our Contact page.

sections.title: Delivery areas
paragraphs: We deliver across Egypt. Greater Cairo and main cities typically receive orders within 3–5 business days. Other areas may take 5–7 business days depending on location. On seasonal or peak periods, delivery may take up to 10 business days.

sections.title: Shipping costs
paragraphs: Shipping is calculated at checkout based on weight and delivery address. Free shipping may apply on orders above a certain value—check the cart page for current offers. Return shipping cost is 50 EGP when the buyer bears return shipping, as stated in our refund policy.

sections.title: Order tracking
paragraphs: Once your order is shipped, we will send you a confirmation and tracking details by email or phone so you can follow your delivery. You will be contacted to confirm delivery date and time.

sections.title: Delivery time
paragraphs: The delivery time for orders at Arcwood ranges between 3–5 working days on regular days. During seasonal or high-demand periods, delivery may take up to 10 working days.

sections.title: 3. Payment

sections.title: سياسة الاسترجاع والاسترداد
paragraphs: استمتع بالتسوق مع ميزات سياسة الاسترجاع التالية:

sections.title: 1. الاسترجاع خلال 14 يوماً
paragraphs: لديك 14 يوماً من تاريخ استلام أي منتج لتقديم طلب استرجاع. يتحمل المشتري تكلفة شحن الاسترجاع البالغة 50 جنيهاً. نقبل الاسترجاع بشرط أن يكون المنتج سليماً وغير مفتوح مع الكرتون والملحقات سليمة. يُسترد المبلغ خلال 14 يوم عمل.

sections.title: 2. المنتجات المعيبة أو غير المطابقة
paragraphs: إذا كان المنتج معيباً أو لا يطابق وصف الموقع، يحق لك إرجاعه خلال 14 يوماً واسترداد سعر المنتج وتكلفة الشحن.

sections.title: 3. مدة تحويل المبلغ
paragraphs: يُحوَّل المبلغ خلال 14 يوم عمل.

sections.title: استلمت منتجاً تالفاً، هل يمكنني استرداد المبلغ؟
paragraphs: يمكنك إرجاع المنتج خلال 14 يوماً بشرط أن يكون بنفس حالة الاستلام مع العبوة الأصلية سليمة. بعد الفحص، نُرجع قيمة المنتج ورسوم الشحن خلال أسبوع.

sections.title: متى لا يكون الاسترجاع ممكناً؟
paragraphs: خارج المدة المحددة؛ المنتج مستخدم أو تالف؛ منتجات مشمولة بضمان المصنع؛ منتجات استُهلكت أو رُكّبت؛ نقص في محتويات الطرد؛ منتجات هشة أو للنظافة الشخصية.

sections.title: من يتحمل رسوم الشحن عند الاسترجاع؟
paragraphs: العميل يشحن المنتج إلى عنواننا خلال 14 يوماً. أركوود تتحمل الشحن فقط إذا كان المنتج غير سليم أو مكسوراً.

sections.title: لماذا لم يُحوَّل المبلغ بعد؟
paragraphs: المعاملات المالية تستغرق من 3 إلى 14 يوم عمل.

sections.title: ما مدة توصيل الطلبات؟
paragraphs: من 3 إلى 5 أيام عمل في الأيام العادية، وقد تصل إلى 10 أيام في المواسم.

sections.title: لماذا لم أتلقَ رداً على شكواي؟
paragraphs: الرد خلال 72 ساعة. حل المشكلات قد يستغرق حتى 14 يوم عمل.

sections.title: مناطق التوصيل
paragraphs: نوصّل داخل مصر. القاهرة الكبرى والمدن الرئيسية خلال 3–5 أيام عمل. المناطق الأخرى 5–7 أيام. في المواسم قد تصل إلى 10 أيام.

sections.title: تكلفة الشحن
paragraphs: تُحسب عند الدفع حسب الوزن والعنوان. قد يتوفر شحن مجاني للطلبات فوق قيمة معينة.

sections.title: تتبع الطلب
paragraphs: بعد الشحن نرسل تأكيداً وتفاصيل التتبع ونتواصل لتأكيد موعد التسليم.

sections.title: مدة التوصيل
paragraphs: من 3 إلى 5 أيام عمل في الأيام العادية، وقد تصل إلى 10 أيام في فترات الذروة.
